title: Demographic Bias of Expert-Level Vision-Language Foundation Models in Medical Imaging

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring underdiagnosis disparity by comparing False Negative Rates (FNR) and False Positive Rates (FPR) between male and female patients, comparing these fairness gaps against board-certified radiologists, and probing model embeddings using logistic regression to detect the encoding of sex.

Measuring underdiagnosis disparity by comparing False Negative Rates (FNR) and False Positive Rates (FPR) across different racial groups (e.g., Black vs. White patients), benchmarking against human radiologists, and probing penultimate layer embeddings to assess how well the model encodes racial information.

Measuring underdiagnosis disparity by evaluating differences in False Negative Rates (FNR) and False Positive Rates (FPR) across age subgroups (e.g., 18-40 vs. >80 years old), comparing disparities to human experts, and using linear attribute prediction heads to detect age encoding in model embeddings.
Evaluating underdiagnosis disparities and algorithmic encoding for intersecting demographic groups (e.g., Black female patients vs. White male patients) to identify compounded fairness gaps.
